Envoy Cast Kit v0.1 · Offline prototype

Dispatch lab

Prepare portable assignments and review returned files. Keep your complete original Stack. This lab stages proposals; acceptance and full revision storage belong in Carbon.

1. Original context

Paste a freshly exported Carbon exact-v1 handoff. It lists omitted files without carrying their bytes.

2. Assignment and Playbooks

Optional Playbooks, in the displayed order:

Inspect or edit Cast permissions and embedded Playbooks

3. Export Dispatch

Review the selected contents before moving them to an authorized AI chat. Copy the complete text below; no provider connection is made.

4. Review Return

No browser storage or external network requests. Save the Cast, original context and Return to continue later. Proposed file downloads do not constitute Stack acceptance. Source HTML is shown literally.

Load an example or original context to begin.
